extDescription.message: Claudio’s Club alerts and quick tasks in Chrome, even with the Club tab closed.

titleNone.message: Claudio’s Club: nothing waiting for you

titleOffline.message: Claudio’s Club offline: open the Club to get alerts

titleRevoked.message: Claudio’s Club: the pairing was revoked, pair again

titleUnpaired.message: Claudio’s Club: pair the extension to get alerts

kindPlan.message: has a plan for you to approve

kindSecret.message: received a secret in the chat

kindRoutine.message: had a routine that did not run

kindOrphan.message: lost its owner after a restart

kindUsage.message: is close to the usage limit

kindBlocked.message: has a task waiting on one that got stuck

kindNotStarted.message: has a task forgotten in To do

notifManyBody.message: Open the Club to see who is waiting for you.

offlineBody.message: Claudio’s Club did not answer. Open the Club and try again; the task is not saved for later.

pairHelp.message: In the Club, open Settings → General → Chrome extension, generate the code and type it here. The code is valid for 5 minutes.

pairInvalid.message: Invalid or expired code. Generate another in the Club.

pairFull.message: Limit of 5 paired extensions: revoke one in the Club settings.

pairRevoked.message: The pairing was revoked. Generate a new code in the Club and pair again.

noStaff.message: No project has an employee yet: hire one in the Club.

attachPage.message: Attach the page URL and title

externalNote.message: External content: it goes to the task as data, not as instructions.

startHint.message: Unchecked: the task stays On hold until you start it.

unpairHint.message: Only forgets the token in this Chrome. To invalidate it for good, revoke it in the Club settings.

errLimited.message: Too many requests: wait $N$ s and try again.

errGeneric.message: That did not work. Try again.
